author: kupatryk
quote: Writing is terrible,what a boring game, all characters are bland, Jason is a soulless "Yes man" that agrees to Lucia every second even though she is a terrible person. What sort of mother leaves their baby so she can do a stick up? But somehow she is the voice of  reason and supposed to be glorified. Jasons mate is annoying not a single drop of "funny" everything seems so forced compared to any other GTA, SA had better writing ffs and people would argue that SAs writing was bad. This is on another level, it was blatenly written by unfunny losers with no edginess to them that thought they got everything spot on.
